name: rekordbox-device
description: rekordbox Device Libraries on USB sticks and SD cards (export.pdb for rekordbox 5 to 7 and every CDJ / XDJ, and the encrypted OneLibrary exportLibrary.db for rekordbox 7 and the newest players, a per-device option): browse them, export a collection to a device, update the collection from it, back up, convert, edit its settings.

settings.label: OneLibrary key (optional)
settings.help: SQLCipher key of exportLibrary.db (OneLibrary, formerly Device Library Plus). Empty: the built-in key, the same on every device.
